ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement (2020-11-30) - explicitly stated
- Borrower name (MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc.) - explicitly stated
- Administrative Agent (Bank of Montreal) - explicitly stated
- Extension fee (5 basis points on Commitment) - explicitly stated in Section 4
- Applicable Margin rates at Level 5 (5.00% for BA/LC/LIBOR, 3.50% for Prime/USBR) - found in Schedule B
- Extended Waiver Period through March 31, 2021 - explicitly defined
- Minimum liquidity requirement ($15,000,000) - stated in Section 2(c)
- All covenant restrictions (no new advances, distribution limits, weekly reporting, etc.) - all found in Section 2
- Event of Default trigger (5 business days for OLG payment cessation) - stated in Section 3
- Original Credit Agreement date (June 10, 2019) - explicitly stated
- Guarantor (Complex Services Inc.) - explicitly stated

The memo accurately represents the financial terms and covenants contained in the source waiver agreement.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original Credit Agreement date (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019)
- Administrative Agent identity (Bank of Montreal)
- Guarantor (Complex Services Inc.)
- Undrawn Fee rate (1.25% at Level 5)
- Specific financial covenant sections being waived (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2)
- Complete pricing grid showing all leverage ratio levels and corresponding rates
- Timeline of previous waivers (May 15, July 31, September 30, 2020)
